content: Konva.js (canvas) needs explicit optimization beyond a few hundred shapes: shape caching (rasterize to image), layer.listening(false) to skip hit-testing, max 3-5 layers (each layer is its own canvas), and viewport culling/virtualization. Naive react-konva with thousands of shapes drops FPS (issue 491). For thousands of markers + photo avatars, must cache avatars as images, cull off-screen nodes, and avoid per-shape event listeners and shadows/strokes on text.
